notes.subject: אספתי ממך
notes.rationale: 'mi olim ol i kamap' (KJV gather) vs 'mi rausim ol i go' (remove) — Hebrew root asaf i gat tupela mining.

notes.subject: ממועד
notes.rationale: 'long ol de bilong festival' (KJV 'solemn assembly') vs JPS 'far from the appointed season' — mi holim pasin bilong KJV.

notes.subject: משאת
notes.rationale: Tok bilong 'hevi bilong kapsaitim' — em i wanpela tok we i no commontum long olgeta ples.

translation: Ol man i sori long ol de bilong festival — ol i bilong yu — mi olsem bai ol i no ken kapsaitim hevi bilong sem ⟨long em⟩.

tokens.gloss: mi olsem bai ol i no ken kapsaitim
